DocAligner LCNet-100 heatmap model, input RGB 256x256, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/DocsaidLab/DocAligner
Byte-identical mirror, commit 5bbd55b58cabc196323ce541e0528deb42c57ee5:
https://github.com/storrealbac/quadscan/blob/5bbd55b58cabc196323ce541e0528deb42c57ee5/models/lcnet100_h_e_bifpn_256_fp32.onnx

4,767,987 bytes; SHA-256 f4117b786e3a18470f3865c93f3c2bd69d9b998edd60f385574a5c665e79594e.
The same checksum is independently published by ml-web-scanner at commit
742583497bfe244910d837d32fc31eec5b97d0b7/models/checksums.json.

The model is unmodified. Heatmap decoding/preprocessing was adapted from the
MIT-licensed quadscan and ml-web-scanner projects; their licenses are included.
All browser inference is local. Only these public model/runtime assets enter
Cache Storage; photographs never enter an asset cache or a third-party service.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1 is vendored separately with its MIT license and third-party
notices. Its 11,246,032-byte CPU SIMD WASM runtime and this model download lazily
on first unmarked scanning use and are cached after SHA-256 verification.
SIMD/Worker/model failures retain an original image and manual corner controls.

Source references and version pinning do not imply a guarantee that every paper,
background, shadow, camera or mobile browser will be detected correctly.
